name: workbench
description: Portable agent workbench: codebase mastery, foundation audits, end-to-end simulation sweeps, potential reading, vision keeping, systemic thinking, reality-checking, exhaustive surface mapping, research, skill recommendations, skill distillation, memory capture, and prompt translation.

interface.shortDescription: Portable codebase mastery, research, memory, prompting, skill-advice, and skill-distillation workflows.
interface.longDescription: A portable workbench for Codex and other coding agents: codebase mastery mode, deep research reports, quick scans, exhaustive surface maps, installed-skill recommendations, workflow-to-skill distillation, prompt translation, and session memory capture. Codex loads these as bundled skills; other runtimes can expose their own adapters.
defaultPrompt: DEVOUR this codebase before we change it.
Run a bedrock audit on the foundations.
Run the gauntlet on this user flow - sweep-test the machinery behind each step.
Run potential - what does this codebase want to become?
Scour the web - are we on the right page about this?
Map the totality of this - the complete surface, provably covered.
Run a quick research scan on this topic.
Recommend the best installed skill for this task.
Distill this workflow into a reusable skill.
Turn this partial idea into a grounded prompt for the right agent or tool.
